item.title: College & Career Fair opens opportunities for Ross Collins students
item.description: Ross Collins Career and Technical Center hosted its 2026 College & Career Fair on Friday, Feb. 27, in the Meridian High School Gym, welcoming students for a morning of opportunity, exploration and connection.

item.title: History comes to life in downtown Meridian

item.title: Meridian Public School District wins Leadership in Governance Award
item.description: The Meridian Public School District was honored with the prestigious Leadership in Governance Award during the Celebration Luncheon at the Mississippi School Boards Association Annual Conference on Feb. 25.

item.title: Meridian council approves Intellisafe contract to tackle school zone speeding
item.description: Drivers failing to abide by school zone speed limits may soon pay a price after the Meridian City Council on Tuesday voted to approve a contract with Intellisafe to use radar guns at locations throughout the city.

item.title: Marion explores options to paint water towers
item.description: Town of Marion officials are exploring their options as they look to repaint and refurbish the town’s two water towers.

item.title: Walker announces Spring Fling Celebration
item.description: Though spring is still a few weeks away, Ward 4 Councilwoman Romande Walker has organized three days of fun and informative activities for families to celebrate its arrival.

item.title: Schools throughout Mississippi seek bus drivers
item.description: As state officials wrestle over teacher pay and debate the merits of public versus private schools, school districts throughout the state are struggling to fill another critical position in education: bus drivers.

item.title: Carmichael, Schanrock visit state Capitol
item.description: Laura Carmichael, director of the Lauderdale County Tourism Commission, and Matt Shanrock, director of Meridian Mainstreet, visited the state Capitol on Wednesday and spoke with Sen. Jeff Tate about tourism.
